source: released Git tag source executed locally, not an npm tarball capture

runtime.dependencies: Existing development checkout dependencies; historical dependencies were not reinstalled.

generation: Extract src/ and package.json from v0.12.1 into a temporary directory.
Initialize a temporary Git repository on main and create one empty commit.
Run the extracted MergeBroker.initialize(repo, { detect: false, agentContract: false }).
Open the extracted MergeBroker and register HISTORICAL-ACTIVE with expectedPaths [src/active.ts].
Register HISTORICAL-CANCELLED with expectedPaths [src/cancelled.ts], then cancelTask(HISTORICAL-CANCELLED).
Capture config.json, state.json, and the returned archive file without modifying their bytes.
limits: Covers recorded formats, migrations, original-byte backups, and subsequent new task registration. The original Git object graph, audit stream, and signing private key are not included; this is not a historical integration or signature-recovery fixture.
